ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 3060 V2 OC Edition 12GB GDDR6 Graphics Card


Deliver the ultimate gaming experience with the ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 3060 V2 OC Edition. Combining dynamic thermal performance with broad compatibility, this powerful graphics card features 12GB of high-speed GDDR6 VRAM, making it the perfect choice for gamers and creators who demand fluid high-frame-rate 1080p and 1440p gameplay, seamless multitasking, and enhanced rendering capabilities in modern AAA titles.


Engineered with two powerful Axial-tech fans featuring smaller hubs for longer blades and a barrier ring to increase downward air pressure, the V2 OC edition ensures your GPU stays incredibly cool and quiet under heavy gaming loads. Utilizing Auto-Extreme Technology to enhance reliability through an automated manufacturing process, and wrapped in a sleek, compact 2-slot design, this heavy-duty card fits effortlessly into a wide variety of chassis setups. Upgrade your rig to NVIDIA Ampere architecture and enjoy real-time ray tracing and AI-accelerated DLSS performance!
